verdict.rationale: smolagents' own docs say it ships official command-line utilities (smolagent, webagent) for running agents without writing boilerplate code, which directly meets the story. The evidence is a single summary mention with no usage detail. Missing for 10: documented CLI command/flag reference and usage examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
